POO_SHORT_LOCATION_DESC: Sonoma Lake Napa Unit
PROJECTED_ACTIVITY_NARR: *west zone*  meyers-fire behavior is minimal with smoldering and creeping. large stump holes are numerous and will retain heat for the foreseeable future.  walbridge-fire activity is generally low consisting of backing and flanking fire. occasionally this results in short uphill runs when the fire reverses slopes in drainage bottoms. pena creek is in alignment with southsouthwest winds. the dorman drainage is not in alignment  however fire on the southern aspect in that drainage will show a marked increase in behavior in the afternoons. in div d the fire is moving to the west towards fern and oak mountains. the area just to the south and east of fern mountain has very broken terrain and the fuel transitions to heavy brush. if the fire moves into the brush fire behavior will increase dramatically.  *east zone* branch xx- fire will continue to creep and smolder in the understory fuels throughout the branch. it will become active with the afternoon wind and make runs with the wind and terrain. potential for fire movement to northnortheast. northwest movement is possible  where local terrain funnels the wind. continued spread northwest around bohn lake with the local terrain winds in the afternoon. fire spread to the south across swartz creek possible. timber and understory fuels are present on the north slopes if the fire crosses the control lines near swartz creek.  branch xxx and branch xl- potential for fire movement to the north along hwy 16  funneled by terrain winds where control line is not present. smoldering of residual fuels will continue. unburned interior islands may harbor heat which can become active with the afternoon winds and may challenge control lines. roll out into unburned fuels can cause uphill runs with the terrain or wind.
